description: A product tile: image, title, price, an optional struck-through original price and badge, and an add-to-cart button. Prices arrive as formatted strings.

props.name: originalPrice
props.description: The formatted price before a discount, shown struck through.

props.name: badge
props.description: A short badge such as `New` or `-20%`.

props.name: addToCartLabel
props.description: The label of the add-to-cart button.

events.name: onTap
events.description: Fires when the card is tapped.

events.name: onAddToCart
events.description: Fires when the add-to-cart button is pressed. The button shows only when this is handled.
